jobs.description:
Alkami is the digital sales and service platform provider for U.S. banks and credit unions. Our unified Platform integrates onboarding, digital banking, and data and marketing—each solution can stand alone, but together they deliver more—to help institutions onboard, engage, and grow relationships. As the future shifts toward Anticipatory Banking, we help data\-informed bankers meet the moment with technology that drives action.

  

Founded in 2009, we continue to be recognized for our intentional culture and tremendous growth (Best Place to Work in Fintech; Best \& Brightest to Work For Nationally; and Comparably’s Best Company Culture, Best Career Growth, Best Engineering Team, and Best Places to Work in Dallas, among others). We’re building a culture where each Alkamist can perform to their highest potential, and we’re always on the lookout for the best and brightest minds. If you’re ready to experience the power of alchemy \- transforming the ordinary into the extraordinary \- come join one of the fastest growing SaaS companies in the U.S.

  

As a remote\-first company, most of our positions can be remote in the US, except for key roles, which will be indicated in the Job Title.

  

Follow us on Glassdoor and LinkedIn!


The Sr Implementation Specialist serves as an experienced implementation professional responsible for leading complex software configuration, testing, and customer onboarding activities across Alkami Digital Banking implementations. This role independently manages implementation execution for diverse customer environments, including onboarding and live\-client work, coordinates cross\-functional delivery efforts, and guides customers through configuration, testing, cutover readiness, and launch activities to ensure successful implementation outcomes and positive customer experiences. The position applies advanced product knowledge, troubleshooting expertise, and project coordination skills to resolve implementation challenges, support operational readiness, and improve implementation quality and efficiency. The Sr Implementation Specialist operates independently on complex engagements, contributes to process improvements, and provides functional leadership within assigned product or implementation ownership areas.
**Essential Duties \&** **Responsibilities**

* Lead complex software implementation activities by configuring and customizing Alkami products to support customer onboarding, testing, training, and launch readiness requirements across diverse implementation environments
* Independently manage customer implementation engagements by coordinating configuration tasks, ticket\-driven workflows, project milestones, and stakeholder alignment across customers, vendors, and internal teams throughout project execution
* Guide customers through user acceptance testing and operational readiness activities by facilitating testing sessions, validating workflows, troubleshooting issues, and supporting implementation and cutover readiness requirements
* Perform advanced functional and integration testing by analyzing system behaviors, validating configurations, documenting results, and resolving implementation\-related discrepancies prior to deployment
* Troubleshoot complex configuration, usability, and implementation issues by performing root\-cause analysis, identifying corrective actions, and coordinating resolution efforts across technical, operational, and vendor stakeholders
* Collaborate with customers and third\-party vendors by gathering configuration requirements, validating implementation details, and ensuring external dependencies are aligned with project timelines and delivery objectives
* Provide regular implementation updates to customers, vendors, and internal stakeholders by communicating project progress, issue resolution status, testing outcomes, and operational risks throughout implementation engagements
* Track and manage implementation activities by maintaining visibility into configuration progress, testing milestones, issue escalations, and project dependencies across multiple concurrent implementations
* Develop and maintain detailed implementation documentation by recording configuration settings, testing outcomes, issue logs, standard operating guidance, and customer and vendor communications throughout the implementation lifecycle
* Support implementation\-related billing coordination by accurately documenting add\-on sales activities, validating billable work, and ensuring implementation\-related charges are properly tracked and communicated
* Serve as a subject matter expert for assigned Alkami products, integrations, or implementation functions by maintaining advanced knowledge, guiding delivery decisions, and supporting consistent execution across customer engagements
* Collaborate with Product, Support, Engineering, and Implementation teams by communicating customer feedback, implementation trends, and operational challenges that influence process improvements and product enhancements
* Manage multiple complex implementation priorities simultaneously by balancing customer needs, testing activities, issue resolution efforts, and project timelines across concurrent engagements
* Contribute to operational improvement initiatives by identifying implementation inefficiencies, recommending workflow enhancements, improving documentation and testing practices, and supporting best\-practice development that improves implementation scalability and customer experience
* Support and mentor less experienced implementation specialists by providing guidance on testing methodologies, troubleshooting practices, customer and vendor communication strategies, and implementation procedures

 **Recommended Experience \& Education**

 ***Minimum Years of Experience***

  

3–6 years of experience leading software implementations, customer onboarding activities, configuration management, testing operations, or technical consulting engagements within SaaS, fintech, banking technology, or related environments.

 ***Education Level*** Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Information Technology, Communications, or a related field.

 **Knowledge, Skills, \& Qualifications**

 **Required**

* Advanced experience supporting software implementations, configuration management, and customer onboarding activities
* Strong troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis skills related to software configuration, testing, vendor coordination, and implementation issues across multiple customer environments
* Ability to independently manage complex implementation projects and competing priorities
* Experience facilitating user acceptance testing, functional validation, and operational readiness activities
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with customer\-facing and cross\-functional stakeholder experience
* Experience collaborating with customers, vendors, and technical teams to coordinate implementation execution
* Ability to maintain detailed implementation documentation and operational tracking materials
* Strong organizational, analytical, and customer relationship management skills in fast\-paced implementation environments


New Logo

* Ability to travel up to 20% to support implementation projects

 **Preferred**

* Experience supporting fintech, SaaS, or digital banking implementation programs
* Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or technical onboarding concepts
* Experience using Jira, Confluence, or similar project management, testing, issue tracking, and documentation platforms
* Experience contributing to process optimization or implementation scalability initiatives
* Knowledge of software deployment, operational readiness, or change management practices
* Experience mentoring implementation specialists or supporting team knowledge\-sharing activities

jobs.title: Product Implementation Lead – US Remote, Eastern or Central Time Zone
jobs.description:
**Location: Remote, US – Eastern or Central Time Zone**

**Reports to: Chief Product Officer**

**Required availability: 7:00 AM – 5:00 PM ET, Monday through Friday**

**Type: Full\-time** 

**About ColigoMed**

ColigoMed is a US healthcare AI company automating the administrative work that slows down specialty care. Our agentic AI platform delivers touchless eligibility and benefits verification, autonomous prior authorization with EMR write\-back, integrated care program enablement (RPM, CCM, PCM, TCM), and hospital readmission reduction, supported by a patient app and a provider app. We are live with 50\+ paying customers across cardiology, pulmonology, and pain management and backed by an $8M seed round from 70\+ physicians.

**The role**

You will be the person customers rely on to get issues resolved and the link between customers, Product, and Engineering. Reporting directly to the CPO, you will own customer inquiries and issues across our platform and patient and provider apps, keep customers informed through resolution, support customer onboarding, and translate customer workflows and needs into clear product requirements.

Resolving customer issues and communicating directly with customers will be a significant part of the role. You will assess the impact and urgency of issues, coordinate with the appropriate teams, and remain accountable for progress through resolution.

You will start each day working with our India, Vietnam, and Romania\-based Engineering teams on priority issues, support our Central and East Coast customers through the business day, and close with a concise check\-in with the CPO.

**What you’ll do**

* **Own customer inquiries and issues**. Act as the primary point of contact for product questions, issues, and escalations from practices and health systems, and see every one through to resolution. Understand the customer’s concern, gather the relevant information, assess its impact and urgency, involve Product, Engineering or other teams when needed, and remain accountable for keeping the issue moving and the customer informed.
* **Track every issue and communicate proactively**. Maintain a clear, current record of every open issue with its owner, status, customer impact, and next step. Update customers before they have to ask: when an issue is logged, when further investigation is required, when a fix or next step is scheduled, and when it is resolved. No customer should ever have to chase us for a status update.
* **Be the eligibility and benefits expert.** Explain eligibility and benefits results to practice staff with confidence: coverage status, plan type, deductibles, copays, coinsurance, out\-of\-pocket maximums, network status, coordination of benefits, and whether a service requires prior authorization. When a result looks wrong, assess where the issue may be occurring and work with the appropriate internal or external team where further investigation is required.
* **Support the provider and patient apps.** Resolve customer\-facing issues across the provider app used by clinicians and care teams and the patient app used by enrolled patients, including login and access, device data syncing, care plan and check\-in workflows, notifications, and data that doesn’t match between the apps and the EMR. Gather and document the relevant information when Product or Engineering investigation is required.
* **Coordinate resolution of complex issues.** When a prior authorization doesn’t submit, a status doesn’t update, an EMR write\-back fails, or patient data doesn’t reach the care team, gather the relevant customer, workflow and system information and work with Product, Engineering, payers, clearinghouses or other partners as appropriate to understand and resolve the issue.
* **Partner with Engineering.** Use the early\-morning overlap to clearly document customer issues, provide the customer and workflow context needed for investigation, help assess customer and business impact and urgency, work with Engineering through resolution, and confirm fixes with customers.
* **Translate customer processes into product requirements**. Map each customer’s front\-office, prior auth, eligibility, and care program workflows in detail, capture their specific requirements, and turn them into clear, testable product requirements and Jira tickets that Engineering can build from. Distinguish what is truly customer\-specific configuration from what should become a product capability for all customers.
* **Identify product gaps**. Recognize patterns across customer issues, payer behavior, app usage, and workflows, and bring them to the CPO with supporting evidence and a recommended priority based on customer and operational impact.
* **Support customer onboarding.** Own assigned onboarding tasks for new customers, including configuration, EMR and payer workflow validation, app setup, and user training support. Validate that workflows work before go\-live and catch early issues before customers do.
* **Report daily to the CPO.** Lead a concise end\-of\-day check\-in with the CPO covering open issues, customer escalations, onboarding progress, product gaps, and priorities for the next morning’s Engineering overlap.
* **Build the playbook**. Maintain payer\-specific troubleshooting guides, app support guides, known\-issue documentation, and customer\-facing help content.
* **Track payer and policy changes**. Flag changes to payer rules, prior auth requirements, benefit manager policies, and CMS guidance that affect how the product behaves.

**What you bring** 

**Required**

* 5\+ years in healthcare RCM, practice operations, implementation, or product support, with at least 2 years in a customer\-facing technical role at a health tech company.
* **Expert command of US eligibility and benefits verification.** You can walk a front\-desk team or practice administrator through a benefits result in plain language across commercial plans, Medicare, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and managed Medicaid.
* Deep, hands\-on knowledge of prior authorization: submission requirements, clinical documentation, status tracking, and peer\-to\-peer and appeals processes.
* Working command of the full revenue cycle: eligibility, charge capture, coding (CPT, ICD\-10, HCPCS), claims, remittance, denials, and appeals.
* Hands\-on working knowledge of at least two of these EMRs: athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, Oracle Health (Cerner), and Epic.
* Hands\-on experience with clearinghouses and multi\-payer portals such as Availity, Waystar, and TriZetto.
* Hands\-on experience with prior authorization and benefit management platforms such as Cohere Health, Evolent, and EviCore, and with payer portals including UnitedHealthcare, Humana, and Oscar.
* Experience supporting web or mobile applications, including troubleshooting user access, data sync, and device or integration issues.
* Experience investigating issues across systems, gathering the information required for resolution, and explaining issues clearly to engineers, practice staff, and patients.
* **Proven ability to translate customer processes into product requirements.** You can sit with a practice, understand exactly how their workflow runs, and write requirements that Engineering can build from without guessing.
* Strong judgment and prioritization skills. You can assess competing customer issues, understand their customer and business impact, determine urgency, and decide when and where escalation is required.
* **Ability to learn and adapt fast.** You get up to speed quickly on new payers, EMRs, workflows, and product areas, and you are comfortable with priorities that change as a fast\-growing company evolves.
* Proficiency with Jira. You write tickets Engineering can act on without follow\-up questions.
* Disciplined issue tracking and proactive customer communication. You keep every issue visible and current, and customers hear from you before they need to ask.
* Experience supporting customer onboarding or implementation projects.
* An acute sense of ownership. You remain accountable for customer communication and progress through resolution, even when another team owns the specialist technical investigation or fix.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including direct communication with US healthcare customers and asynchronous work with international teams.

**Preferred**

* Experience with all four EMRs listed above.
* Familiarity with X12 transactions (270/271, 278, 837, 835\), HL7, or FHIR.
* SQL or comfort querying data to support investigations.
* Experience in cardiology, pulmonology, or pain management practices.
* Exposure to RPM, CCM, or other CMS care management programs, including patient\-facing remote monitoring apps and connected devices.
* Understanding of HIPAA requirements for patient\-facing support.

**Working hours**

This is a full\-time position requiring regular availability from 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM ET, Monday through Friday.

The early start provides overlap with our Engineering teams in India, Vietnam and Romania so priority customer and product issues can be progressed before US customers begin their business day, followed by direct support for our East Coast customers through the business day.

The role requires availability throughout this coverage window, with reasonable flexibility to manage meal and personal breaks around customer and business requirements. Each day closes with a concise check\-in with the CPO.

**What success looks like in 90 days**

* You are the go\-to owner for customer inquiries and issues across the platform and both apps, with a defined issue\-management and escalation process in place.
* You are effectively coordinating customer issues with Product, Engineering and other teams and ensuring they continue to progress through resolution.
* Issues identified during the early Engineering overlap are progressed with the appropriate teams before customers encounter them wherever possible.
* Every open issue is tracked with an owner, status, and next step, and customers receive proactive updates without having to follow up.
* You are independently running assigned onboarding tasks for new customers.
* The daily CPO check\-in is a reliable, concise summary of issues, escalations, onboarding, and priorities.
* You have built payer\-specific troubleshooting guides for our highest\-volume payers and a support guide for the patient and provider apps.
* You have translated customer workflows into product requirements that Engineering has built from, with minimal clarification needed.
* You have brought forward a set of product gaps as clear, prioritized Jira tickets backed by customer evidence.

You are working independently across our main payers, EMRs, customer workflows and both apps, while effectively coordinating with Product and Engineering when specialist technical input is required.

**Why join**

* Work on a problem that directly affects whether patients get timely care.
* Report directly to the CPO and shape the product roadmap from day one.
* Work alongside physician investors and a founding team with multiple exits.

**Compensation:**  The position in salary range will take into account an assessment based on factors including the candidate's level of experience, education, skills, and location. A fully discretionary annual bonus of up to 10% of base salary and a stock option plan also applies. Eligibility for benefits commences after completing a two month introductory period.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $95,000\.00 \- $110,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Referral program
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Are you able to work remotely Monday through Friday and remain available from 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time? Answer Yes or No

Experience:

* healthcare RCM, practice ops, implementation or support: 5 years (Required)
* US healthcare eligibility/benefits \& prior authorization: 2 years (Required)
* working with 2\+ EMR's \- athena, eCW, Cerner or Epic: 2 years (Required)
* a Customer\-facing technical role in health technology: 2 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Health Information Supervisor
jobs.description:
**Introduction**
----------------

  

The Department of Corrections (DOC) is focused on public safety through the custody and supervision of those in our care. Corrections employees have the opportunity to positively impact the lives of others through careers in a variety of fields. Using evidence\-based approaches, employees implement lasting change with a positive impact for the people of Wisconsin.


The Division of Management Services is currently recruiting to fill a Health Information Supervisor position. This position will be headquartered at Dodge Correctional Institution in Waupun, WI.


**Position Summary**
--------------------

  

This position provides professional guidance in the planning, implementation, coordination, monitoring, and evaluation of the DOC’s health information program, including management of paper Health Care Records (HCRs) and the Electronic Medical Record (EMR). This position will provide high level oversight and assistance to the Bureau of Health Services (BHS) in drafting and overseeing implementation of policies relating to management of patient health records compliant with Wisconsin statutes and federal HIPAA regulations. This position also provides direct supervision of employees and overseeing their release of information work, and in guiding HCR project related work.
  

  

This position also provides professional and technical consultation to other state agencies regarding patient medical records and other BHS records, such as substance use disorder (SUD) treatment records, and conducts audits on HCR access and utilization regarding all Persons in Our Care (PIOC) across DOC’s 36 prisons. This position assists with policy development and overseeing policy implementation and training on all DOC HCR access, collection, retention, release, privacy and destruction. Additionally, this position provides ongoing professional leadership in guiding the DMS initiative to convert outstanding paper HCRs into electronic files for storage and ready access in the EMR and oversees the project coordinator who serves as the lead worker on this initiative.


**Salary Information**
----------------------

  

The starting pay is between $58739 and $96720 per year, plus excellent benefits. Pay will be set in accordance with the Compensation Plan and Wisconsin Administrative Code in effect at the time of hire. The pay schedule/range is 81\-03\. A 12\-month probationary period is required.


In addition to meaningful and rewarding work, we offer a competitive benefits package featuring:


* Substantial leave time including at least 3\.5 weeks of vacation to start, 9 paid holidays, and ample accrued sick time that rolls over each year.
* Insurance: Excellent and affordable health, dental, vision, and life insurance.
* An exceptional pension plan including a lifetime retirement payment.
* An optional tax\-advantaged 457 retirement savings plan.
* The *Well Wisconsin Program* helps participants set health and well\-being goals, track progress, stay motivated, and earn incentives.
* Our Employee Assistance Program offers employees and their immediate family a variety of tools, resources, and professional consultation services to support their health, goals, and overall well\-being.
* DOC is a qualifying employer for the *Public Service Loan Forgiveness* program.
* Please click here for a summary of State of Wisconsin employment benefits or click here to explore employment benefits on the website.

To help you understand what your benefit package would be worth, please see the Total Rewards Calculator here.


**Job Details**
---------------

  

Applicants must be legally entitled to work in the United States (i.e., a citizen or national of the U.S., a lawful permanent resident, an alien authorized to work in the U.S. without DOC sponsorship) at the time of application. The Department of Corrections will conduct criminal background checks on applicants prior to selection to determine whether the circumstances of any conviction may be related to the job being filled. Upon hire, all new DOC employees are subject to fingerprinting.


The Department of Corrections may conduct pre\-employment drug screens. Any applicant who is offered employment in a position which requires a pre\-employment drug screen must pass the screen as a contingency to employment.

  

  

**NOTE: This position is eligible to work remotely up to 3 days per week.**


**Qualifications**
------------------

  

**Minimally qualified candidates will have experience:**


* Auditing medical records for compliance with established policies and/or procedures


* Developing and implementing programs policies, procedures, and/or guidelines pertaining to health information


* Leading or supervising staff (assigning/reviewing work, training, etc.)

  

**In addition to the above, well qualified candidates will have experience:**


* Utilizing electronic medical records


* Supervising staff in a healthcare setting


**How To Apply**
----------------

  

To apply, click on “Apply for Job” to start the application process. Follow the steps outlined in the application process and submit your application. Permanent classified employees who are eligible for consideration as a transfer or voluntary demotion must complete the application process in order to be considered.
  

  

Applicants should attach a letter of qualifications and resume detailing their training and experience relating to the qualifications mentioned above. It is not necessary to include references at this time. Your letter of qualifications and resume will be evaluated and is considered the assessment for this position and **should be limited to a maximum of two pages each.**
  

  

Your submission will be evaluated by one or more job experts. The most eligible candidates will be invited to participate in the next step of the selection process. The Department of Corrections has created extra guidance to assist you in developing your resume and letter of qualifications, if interested please click **here****.**
  

  

Questions can be directed to Phia Vang, Human Resources Specialist at Phia.Vang@wisconsin.gov.
  

  

The State of Wisconsin is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer seeking a diverse and talented workforce. We provide reasonable accommodations to applicants and employees with disabilities.
  

  

The State of Wisconsin offers a special program for qualified veterans with a 30% or greater service\-connected disability. If you are a qualified veteran, please visit the Veterans Employment page for application instructions to be considered for the Veterans Non\-Competitive Appointment program.


**Deadline to Apply**
---------------------

  

Online applications and materials must be submitted by 11:59pm on **October 11th, 2026\.**

Guided by our principles of value generation, continuous innovation, customer\-centricity, and vested collaboration, Blue Water Thinking proudly supports our Federal clients in achieving their Agency goals.



Founded by a decorated twenty\-eight year Veteran of the United States Army, Blue Water Thinking understands and supports the mission of our Nation's war fighters, Veterans, their families and caretakers.



Leveraging our executive team's military experience and private and public sector consulting expertise, Blue Water Thinking takes an integrated "one\-team" approach and brings to bear best\-fit solutions, thought leadership, and grit to meet our client's transformational needs.



Fueled by our values of integrity, respect, professionalism, stewardship and customer service, the Blue Water Thinking team understands the power of the human connection, collaboration, humility and loyalty to one another, our clients and industry partners.



Lastly, our formula for success is simple: Build something good, take care of our people, keep our clients satisfied, nurture our work ethic and reputation, build long\-lasting partnerships, enjoy what we do and give back as much as possible.

**Job Description:**



The Interoperability Project Manager supports healthcare technology management (HTM) interface work associated with the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Federal Electronic Health Record Modernization (FEHRM) program. This role coordinates simultaneous interface workstreams across multiple VA medical centers. The Project Manager works directly with national, regional, and site\-level Biomedical Engineering and clinical teams, technical teams, Oracle Health, third\-party vendors, and program management offices across the VA enterprise.



Successful candidates bring recent, practical experience with healthcare interfaces, medical device integration, HTM operations, or healthcare technology deployment, along with strong project coordination skills. They can participate in a technical discussion, recognize an open issue, ask questions to understand its workflow and milestone impacts, and communicate those impacts clearly to leadership.


***\*Travel associated with this role will consist of being away for about a week every 2 months\****


**Responsibilities:**


* Ability to coordinate interface planning, schedules, dependencies, testing, issue resolution, and deployment milestones across technical, vendor, and VA site teams in a large\-scale program with multiple concurrent hospital systems.
* Participate actively in interface and workflow discussions with Oracle Health, facility teams, and technical specialists. Ask focused questions to clarify requirements, ownership, open issues, and next steps.
* Recognize when a technical or workflow issue may affect testing, deployment readiness, or another project milestone; document the impact and escalate concerns at the appropriate time.
* Track decisions, risks, action items, and owners through resolution across multiple facilities and stakeholders.
* Translate detailed interface discussions into accurate meeting documentation, status reports, executive summaries, and leadership briefings.
* Coordinate follow\-up among Biomedical Engineering, clinical staff, technical teams, vendors, and program stakeholders.
* Support interface work throughout planning, testing, deployment, and post\-deployment follow\-up.
* Work within applicable VHA processes, federal requirements, and healthcare technology practices.


**Required Qualifications:**


* Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and at least 5? (or should this be 3\) years of relevant professional experience.
* Recent, practical experience with healthcare interfaces, medical device integration, hospital HTM operations, or healthcare systems implementation.
* Experience coordinating projects or complex work across technical, clinical, vendor, and leadership stakeholders.
* Working understanding of interface activities sufficient to follow technical discussions, identify unresolved questions, and recognize project or workflow impacts.
* Ability to ask useful technical follow\-up questions, drive action items to resolution, and communicate issues clearly to technical teams and leadership.
* Self\-starter with strong organizational skills, sound judgment, intellectual curiosity, and excellent written and verbal communication skills.


**Preferred Qualifications:**


* Experience supporting VA or VHA operations or a multi\-facility EHR deployment.
* Familiarity with Oracle Health Cerner Millennium or VA FEHRM.
* Familiarity with HL7 messaging or healthcare interface testing; expert\-level HL7 proficiency is not required.
* Experience with medical device, imaging, laboratory, or other clinical system interfaces.
* Familiarity with applicable healthcare regulatory requirements and standards.
* Experience using tools, including AI\-assisted tools, to improve documentation, analysis, or workflow efficiency.


**Eligibility Requirements:**


* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship.
* Must be able to obtain and maintain a federal public trust clearance.


**Compensation:**



Salary for this position is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, location, the candidate's particular combination of knowledge, skills, competencies and experience, as well as contract specific affordability and organizational requirements. jobs.description:
**Introduction**

Retina Consultants of America is identifying and evaluating candidates for the position of **System Implementation Project Lead**. This position will report to the Director of System Operations. The System Implementation Project Lead role is a highly visible and challenging role that will help execute the vision of the company’s long\-term and short\-term strategy and become an integral member of a dynamic and experienced operational team.

**Our Company**

Retina Consultants of America (RCA) is bringing together national leaders in surgical and clinical care. This network comprises preeminent retina research specialists with the common goal of eradicating blindness caused by macular degeneration, diabetic retinopathy, and other retina diseases.

With over 2\.3M annual patient visits, more than 315 physicians, and more than 295 locations, Retina Consultants of America (RCA) is the largest retina care provider in the nation.

**Our Mission**

Through RCA’s physician\-centered practice management model, physicians continue to drive clinical care and practice culture, while benefiting from the business expertise, resources and sharing best practices.

RCA seeks to expand our mission by partnering with leading retina specialists who are passionate about delivering excellent patient care and participating in innovative research.

RCA has created a business model that enables retina specialists to retain autonomy and ownership, augmented by sharing best practices facilitated through the Medical Leadership Board and executive management support. Practices within the network will continue to drive all clinical decisions and remain highly involved in strategic operations.

**Our Core Values**

· Relentlessly Commit to our Patients, to the Practices We Serve and to Our Mission

· Embrace the Legacies of Our Partner Practices

· Strive for Continuous Improvement Through Education and Research

· Exude Compassion in All We Do

**Position Overview**

The System Implementation Project Lead is responsible for managing and overseeing implementations of new EHR/PM systems and ancillary products simultaneously across multiple practices within the platform. They will collaborate with key stakeholders, practice RCM and Clinical leaders, and other departments within the company to ensure that all key project milestones and timelines are achieved. The System Implementation Project Lead role requires comprehensive knowledge of physician revenue cycle management and clinical workflows to successfully lead implementations, align operational and clinical processes, and drive performance improvement. The ideal candidate demonstrates attention to detail, accountability, accuracy, sound business judgment, and the ability to balance organizational goals with the needs of providers, staff, and patients.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities** 

**Project Leadership \& Execution**

* Lead implementation projects for clinical and operational systems, including EHR, Practice Management, patient engagement, and other healthcare technology platforms.
* Develop and manage project plans, timelines, resources, budgets, and deliverables.
* Monitor project progress, mitigate risks, and ensure successful on\-time, in\-scope project completion.
* Facilitate project meetings, status reporting, and executive communications.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with clinical, operational, revenue cycle, and IT teams to support system implementations and workflow optimization.
* Coordinate activities impacting scheduling, registration, documentation, billing, coding, collections, and reporting.
* Serve as the primary liaison between internal stakeholders and external vendors.
* Align implementation efforts with organizational, financial, and patient care objectives.

**Change Management \& System Adoption**

* Oversee system testing, validation, go\-live readiness, and post\-implementation stabilization.
* Support training and change management initiatives to drive user adoption and operational success.
* Facilitate issue resolution and continuous process improvement.

**Vendor \& Compliance Management**

* Manage vendor relationships, project deliverables, and implementation timelines.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory, privacy, and security requirements.
* Track implementation metrics and measure outcomes against established goals.

**Knowledge, Skills, Abilities**

* Ability to direct and lead multiple projects concurrently.
* Knowledgeable in defining approach and resource requirements for projects.
* Strong organizational, customer service, interpersonal, facilitation, communication, and time management skills
* Outstanding poise in a fast\-paced business environment
* Ability to work both independently and in a team setting.

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree (preference Project Management or Healthcare Administration) and/or 5 years of physician practice experience
* Minimum of 5 years’ experience in Project Management or Lead Position
* Experience in providing cross\-functional support for a corporate team.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
* Proficient in Microsoft Outlook
* Proficient in Monday.com
* Experience and ability to navigate practice EHR PM systems and RCM/data reporting tools (Nextech, NextGen, Tableau, DOMO experience, a plus)

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Have you implemented Nextech Practice Plus \- Practice Management System?

Work Location: Remote

**Overview**
============


Sentara Health is now hiring an **IT Director, Clinical Systems**. This position will work remotely but must live within a drivable distance to Virginia Beach. The IT Director, Clinical Systems provides strategic, operational, and people leadership for the technology solutions supporting hospital\-based clinical operations.  



  

This role is accountable for the performance, optimization, governance, and future direction of the clinical systems portfolio supporting Pharmacy, Laboratory Services, Inpatient Physicians, Inpatient Nursing, Emergency Department, Research, Infection Prevention, Capacity Management, Throughput, and other hospital\-based clinical service lines.  



  

The Director serves as the primary IT executive partner for operational and clinical leaders, ensuring technology investments align with organizational priorities, improve patient outcomes, enhance caregiver experience, and support operational excellence.

**Education**
=============

or

* *At least 8 years of relevant management experience in lieu of bachelor's degree*

==============

**Duties and Responsibilities**
===============================

* **Strategic Leadership \& Business Partnership**

	+ Lead, coach, and develop a team of managers, analysts, and technical professionals.

	+ Build leadership bench strength and succession plans.
	+ Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.

	+ Present portfolio status, risks, investment needs, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership.
	+ Build trusted relationships with physicians, nursing leadership, department directors, and operational partners.

jobs.description:
At Caregenix, we are committed to delivering exceptional, value\-based care. Our team lives by the iCare values—Integrity, Compassion, Accountability, Respect, and Excellence—in everything we do. If you are passionate about improving patient outcomes and providing compassionate care in a remote setting, we want to hear from you.

**Overview**

The Onboarding Team Lead \& Account Project Manager builds and leads CareGenix's U.S.\-based, in\-person onboarding front line. This role owns the kickoff call and staff training for every new partner account in person — "boots on the ground" — and acts as that account's dedicated Project Manager, running the executive alignment meeting with the partner's own COO, CEO, CMO, and CFO to confirm the program is set up correctly, with their input, before rollout.

***Essential Duties \& Responsibilities***

**Account Project Management \& Executive Alignment**

▪ Serve as the single point of accountability for each new account from kickoff through go\-live.

▪ Schedule and lead the executive alignment meeting for every new partner account, engaging the partner's COO, CEO, CMO, and CFO.

▪ Capture each executive's input and confirm the program is configured to the partner organization's needs before rollout begins.

▪ Document attendance, decisions, and sign\-off from each executive alignment meeting and file it with the account record.

**On\-Site Onboarding \& Training**

▪ Conduct the in\-person kickoff call at each new partner site.

▪ Lead on\-site staff training for partner/practice staff on CareGenix systems, portals, and workflows.

▪ Provide go\-live support and coordinate final sign\-off with the partner and internal teams.

**Cross\-Functional Coordination**

▪ Coordinate with administrative onboarding team on agreements, BAA, Practice Information Form, EMR/eligibility, caller ID, and billing setup — without duplicating that work.

▪ Maintain the shared onboarding tracker/checklist so no step falls between the two tracks.

▪ Run a standing weekly sync with the administrative onboarding team.

**Team Leadership**

▪ Hire, train, and manage 2–3 U.S.\-based Onboarding Specialists as the team scales.

▪ Assign specialist coverage by region or customer segment.

▪ Serve as the escalation point for onboarding issues raised by partner leadership or internal teams.

***Qualifications***

▪ Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in healthcare operations, project management, or a related field.

▪ 3\+ years of experience in healthcare operations, account/customer management, or project management — value\-based care, RPM/CCM, or another ambulatory\-care setting preferred.

▪ Demonstrated ability to communicate confidently and credibly with C\-suite executives (COO, CEO, CMO, CFO).

▪ Strong project management, organizational, and follow\-through skills; comfortable owning an account from kickoff through go\-live.

▪ Working knowledge of HIPAA and PHI handling requirements.

▪ PMP or similar project management certification a plus, not required.

▪ Willing and able to travel regularly for in\-person site visits.

***Travel, Physical \& Work Requirements***

▪ Regular travel to partner practice sites required.

▪ Valid driver's license and ability to travel independently between sites.

▪ Ability to stand, present, and facilitate training sessions for extended periods during on\-site visits.

▪ Ability to transport basic training materials and equipment to and from site visits.

▪ Maintains a home\-office work setup for administrative and remote coordination work between site visits.

The Acquisition Training Specialist V provides acquisition training materials, maintains training databases, operates the Learning Management System (LMS), conducts training, collects and analyzes training class feedback, responds to Service Desk inquiries that require training refresher, and creates desk guides.  



  

**Chickasaw Nation Industries, Inc.** serves as a holding company with multiple subsidiaries engaged in several lines of business (Business Services, Health, Infrastructure and Engineering, Mission Optimization, Technology and Transportation) for the federal government and commercial enterprises. A portion of our profits is used to support Chickasaw citizens. We are proud to support the economic development and long\-term viability of the Chickasaw Nation and its people. CNI offers premium benefits eligible on the first day of hire to full time employees; (Medical \- Dental – Vision), Company Life Insurance, Short\-Term and Long\-Term Disability Insurance, 401(K) Immediate Vesting, Professional Development Assistance, Legal Aid Assistance Program, Family Planning / Fertility Assistance, Personal Time Off, and Observance of Federal Holidays.  



As a federal contractor, CNI is a drug\-free workplace and adheres to the Federal Controlled Substance Act.  



  

All candidates must be able to obtain and maintain a Secret clearance, as well as pass a drug screen and background check.  



  

**ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS**

Must be able to obtain and maintain the required customer clearance for access to systems, facilities, equipment and property.  



Expert\-level experience leading acquisition, procurement, contracting, or federal training programs.  



  

Expert knowledge of the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) and Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS) including the Revolutionary FAR Overhaul. Experience with Navy Marine Corps Acquisition Regulation Supplement (NMCARS), Other Transaction Authority (OTAs), and Construction contracts.  



Demonstrates the ability to design and manage complex training strategies and curriculum frameworks.  



Demonstrates deep understanding of acquisition processes, procurement policy, and adult learning methodologies.  



  

Maintaining content in Atlassian Confluence, Navy Electronic Procurement System (ePS) (or similar contract writing system), Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment (PIEE) applications (to include Clause Logic Service), and Cornerstone LMS.  



  

Understanding of various acquisition methods and contract types, including commercial and non\-commercial acquisitions, fixed\-price contracts, and cost\-reimbursement contract types.  



  

Acquisition lifecycle expertise to include contract closeout and unliquidated obligation (ULO) modification procedures.  



**KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

Essential Duties and responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.  



Creates acquisition training material, maintain training database, conduct training, respond to Service Desk inquiries that require training refresher, create desk guides.  



  

Manages training logistics, advertise training opportunities to stakeholders, operate the Learning Management System (LMS), and collect and analyze training class feedback.  



  

Quickly digest procurement policy updates from the Department of the Navy (DON) and Department of War (DOW) and create relevant, concise, applicable, and engaging training courses and self\-help materials or videos to train staff and keep them abreast of the ever\-changing regulations.  



  

Leads the overall strategy, planning, development, implementation, and evaluation of acquisition training programs.  



Serves as a senior advisor for acquisition training needs, curriculum design, training modernization, and workforce learning solutions.  



Oversees creation of high\-impact training courses, desk guides, self\-help tools, videos, job aids, FAQs, and other performance\-support materials.  



Rapidly evaluates procurement policy and regulatory updates from applicable federal sources and guides development of timely training responses.  



Establishes standards for training content quality, instructional design, LMS usage, feedback analysis, and training records management.  



Leads cross\-functional collaboration with acquisition leadership, policy teams, system owners, Service Desk teams, and subject matter experts.  



Oversees LMS course architecture, catalog management, reporting strategy, training completion tracking, and data quality.  



Uses training metrics, feedback results, Service Desk trends, and stakeholder input to identify learning gaps and recommend program improvements.  



Leads major training rollouts related to policy updates, system changes, process improvements, or acquisition workforce initiatives.  



Mentors and guides training specialists across all levels.  



Develops executive\-level reports, briefings, dashboards, and recommendations related to training performance and workforce readiness.  



Supports continuous improvement, innovation, and modernization of training delivery methods, including eLearning, microlearning, virtual instruction, and self\-service resources.  



**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

Master's degree in a related field, and a minimum of ten or more (10\+) years as a Department of War (DOW, formerly DoD) contract specialist (1102 job series), or equivalent combination of education/experience.  



  

Minimum of 5 years of adult learning, knowledge transfer, and course preparation relevant experience within the previous 15 years  



  

DAWIA Level II, Contracting Professional Certification, Certified Federal Contract Manager (CFCM), or equivalent  



  

Expert\-level experience with DOW acquisition policy, practices, and procedures  



  

Expert\-level experience with Defense contractor industry business practices/procedures  



  

Expert\-level Technical understanding/credibility interpreting federal/DOW acquisition regulations via oral and written communication

Work is primarily performed in an office environment. Regularly required to sit. Regularly required use hands to finger, handle, or feel, reach with hands and arms to handle objects and operate tools, computer, and/or controls. Required to speak and hear. Occasionally required to stand, walk and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. Must frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.
